title: Event Brief
description: Plan an event with a dedicated crew.

guide.intro: Turn an event brief into a coordinated plan with Casey, Dylan, Alex and Morgan.
points: Choose Plan an event and enter your audience, goals and event details.
Prepare the demo, then start the event plan. Casey coordinates the fixed crew's contributions.
Follow the team's progress and open the results to review demo ideas, staffing and the event webpage.
guide.note: Your event conversations and results stay saved when you switch spaces.

title: Open Task
description: Bring a task. Casey assembles the team.

guide.intro: Bring Casey a task. Casey assembles the right team to help you complete it.
points: Message Casey with /goal and describe the result you want. Attach documents if your task uses files.
Casey assigns work to the relevant specialists and reviews their contributions.
Follow assignments and progress in Mission Control, then open the team response and any saved files.
guide.note: For a direct conversation with Casey, remove /goal. Your conversations and results stay saved when you switch spaces.
